primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Change from baseline to Week 24 in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Functional Rating Scale-Revised (ALSFRS-R) total score using MMRM without multiple imputation; rating scale 0 to 48; higher scores indicate better functional status

groups.description:
Participants in this arm take 2 reldesemtiv 150 mg oral tablets twice a day for a 600 mg total daily dose from Day 1 until Week 24.

Reldesemtiv: Reldesemtiv Oral Tablet
groups.title: Reldesemtiv Group, Double-Blind Period

groups.description:
Participants in this arm take 2 placebo oral tablets twice a day from Day 1 until Week 24.

Placebo: Placebo Oral Tablet
groups.title: Placebo Group, Double-Blind Period

primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Effect of Reldesemtiv Versus Placebo on Functional Outcomes in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
